Product Details: The 18V LXT® Brushless 1/2" Driver-Drill (XFD16) is a premium drilling and driving solution. The efficient brushless motor is electronically controlled to optimize battery power consumption for up to 50% longer operating time per charge.The XFD16 delivers 970 inch.lbs. by Max Torque. It has a 2-speed transmission (0-550 and 0-1,800 rpm) for a wide range of drilling and fastening applications. The all-metal 1/2" self-tapping chuck offers improved bit grip strength and durability.Useful features include L.E.D lights to illuminate the work area and a rubberized soft grip that provides greater driver comfort. It weighs only 2.1 kg. With a fully charged 5.0Ah battery for reduced driver fatigue (sold separately). It has a compact and ergonomic design with a length of only 6-7/8 inches.It is part of Makita's growing 18V LXT System, the world's largest cordless tool system powered by 18V lithium-ion slide-style batteries. Makita® 18V LXT® Lithium-Ion Batteries have the fastest charging times in their categories, so they spend more time working and less time sitting on the charger.For improved tool performance and longer battery life, Makita created Star Protection Computer Controls™. Star Protection is communication technology that allows the Star Protection tool and battery to exchange data in real time and monitor conditions during use to protect against overload, over-discharge and overheating. For greater versatility, the tool can also be powered by Makita® 18V LXT® Lithium-Ion Batteries with the star symbol on the battery indicating Star Protection inside.
